title: Installer campaigns
summary: State checks follow the Apply journey that creates their subject; token existence and owner-only modes have separate diagnostics. Review captures the full pending-write list and already-saved token reuse before backing out. Browser approval requires a visible control and same-tab confirmation or navigation. Machine-only late-harness discovery checks unattended permissions; project hook trust and received context require exploration proof. Hosted recovery retains fail-fast backup assertions and post-exit capture readiness; source correctness does not establish live campaign acceptance.
